nina: FYI deploy-bot flagged v3.8.1 rollout for /embeddings. p95 up ~+48%. Auto-throttle to 25%. propose: brief stabilize window, route-split, or scoped rollback. whos on ops?

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v3.8.1. Current traffic: 25%. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 45% (5m). Suggested actions: wait 10m; split traffic to fallback; manual rollback to v3.7.5.

ops-oncall: i'm on. prefer traffic split first to limit blast radius. if no improvement in 12m -> execute rollback.

leo: i can cut a 90/10 split (v3.8.1/v3.7.5) in ~4m and prep rollback command.

product: capturing a short customer note now: "temporary traffic reduction applied while we investigate embeddings latency." will post if we rollback.

nina: leo, go ahead with 90/10. i'll watch traces and disable autorevert for this thread.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert paused by operator request. Autorevert window paused until 4367898000.

ops-oncall: split applied. t+6m update: p95 down to +30% from +48%. holding to t+12m, rollback if it stops improving.
